lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows spanning the mid-lateral region from the posterior gill slits to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Approximately nine to ten vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined rectangular grid of nodes between the first and second dorsal fin longitudinal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, each exhibiting a high-luminance crest and a distinct low-luminance shadow immediately ventral to the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 15-20 discrete high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration localized along the anterior margin and mid-section of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible remora attachments on the ventral surface posterior to the pectoral fin; exceptionally high density of micro-blobs on the snout region anterior to the first gill slit.
